tagline.en: Order form for the CS team with multi-courier shipping via KiriminAja.

summary.id: Arunika dipakai tim customer service untuk mencatat order pelanggan: data penerima, alamat sesuai wilayah KiriminAja, produk, promo, dan metode bayar COD atau transfer. Order dikirim ke KiriminAja untuk pickup dan resi, lalu status paket diperbarui otomatis lewat webhook. Admin bisa memverifikasi bukti transfer, memantau kendala pengiriman, dan mengekspor label serta rekap order.
summary.en: Arunika is used by the customer service team to record customer orders: recipient details, an address matched to KiriminAja's area data, products, promos, and COD or bank-transfer payment. Orders are sent to KiriminAja for pickup and an AWB, and package status updates arrive automatically via webhook. Admins can verify transfer proofs, watch delivery issues, and export labels and order recaps.

tagline.id: Tagging bank footage dengan AI dan rakit video pendek otomatis dari brief.
tagline.en: AI tagging for a footage bank and automatic short-video assembly from a brief.

summary.id: Clipper dipakai tim konten untuk mengelola bank footage syuting di Google Drive. Worker memberi tag tiap klip (produk, peran adegan, karakter, skor) dengan AI, transkrip, dan pengenalan wajah lokal, lalu reviewer memastikan tag-nya benar. Dari klip yang layak, Clipper merakit beberapa varian video otomatis sesuai brief, lalu video melewati QC sampai diposting. App ini menggantikan spreadsheet log footage yang sebelumnya diisi manual.
summary.en: Clipper helps the content team manage the shooting footage bank stored in Google Drive. A worker tags every clip (product, scene role, character, scores) using AI, transcription, and local face recognition, and reviewers confirm the tags. From approved clips, Clipper assembles several video variants automatically from a brief, and each video goes through QC until it is posted. It replaces a manually filled footage log spreadsheet.

summary.id: Dipakai tim konten untuk membagikan satu video ke banyak akun TikTok dari satu meja kerja. Manajer mengunggah video dan caption di web, sistem mengirim video ke galeri HP yang tercolok ke PC Station (akun keranjang kuning) atau ke draft TikTok lewat API (akun publik). Operator tetap menekan Post sendiri, lalu app mencatat waktu posting, target harian per akun, kondisi HP, dan performa video.
summary.en: Used by the content team to distribute one video to many TikTok accounts from a single workstation. Managers upload a video and caption on the web; the system pushes it to the gallery of phones plugged into a PC Station (shopping-cart accounts) or to a TikTok draft via API (public accounts). Operators still press Post themselves, and the app tracks posting time, daily targets per account, phone health, and video performance.

summary.id: Sakta dipakai tim Host Management untuk mengatur host live streaming jualan di beberapa studio, brand, dan platform.
